meta.title: 怎么在公园/爬山时拍出生命力活人感照片！
meta.title_en: How to Take Alive, Natural-Looking Photos in the Park or on a Hike
meta.topic: 户外拍照 · 姿势教学

scenes.title_cn: 站姿细节：挡肉与高低肩
scenes.title_en: Standing Details: Cover and Add an Uneven Shoulder
scenes.context: 顶胯姿势容易挤出腰侧肉肉，用手挡住、制造高低肩、控制抬腿幅度。语域：生活教学，纠正示范。
sentences: 这样顶胯容易挤出腰侧的肉肉。
Posing like this can squeeze out the flesh at your waist.
squeeze out the flesh（挤出肉肉）
我们可以用手挡住。
We can just cover it with your hand.
cover it with your hand（用手挡住）
然后高低肩一下。
Then make one shoulder higher than the other.
uneven shoulders（高低肩）
paraphrase: 挤出肉肉 → squeeze out the flesh / pinch the skin
高低肩 → uneven shoulders / one shoulder higher
scenes.speak: Posing like this can squeeze out the flesh at your waist. We can just cover it with your hand. Then make one shoulder higher than the other.

scenes.title_en: Reach for the Bag Strap: An Easy Outdoor Pose
scenes.context: 公园或爬山时，稍稍侧身、伸手扯住包带，就能得到有生命力的活人感照片。语域：生活教学，动作引导。
sentences: 在公园或者爬山的时候。
When you're in the park or out on a hike.
out on a hike（去爬山）
稍稍侧身，伸手扯住包带。
Turn sideways a bit and reach for your bag strap.
turn sideways（侧身）；bag strap（包带）
就能得到活人感照片。
That gives you an alive, natural-looking photo.
alive, natural-looking（有生命力、活人感）
paraphrase: 侧身 → turn sideways / angle your body
活人感 → natural-looking / full of life
scenes.speak: When you're in the park or out on a hike, turn sideways a bit and reach for your bag strap. That gives you an alive, natural-looking photo.

scenes.title_en: Keep Moving: Kicks and a Tree Hug
scenes.context: 张开双手踢腿要放开幅度；遇到低矮的树可以整个抱住。语域：生活教学，动作引导。
sentences: 张开双手踢腿，不是这样。
Open your arms and kick your leg — not like that.
open your arms（张开双手）；kick your leg（踢腿）
你得这样，动作放开。
Do it like this instead — let the move be big.
let the move be big（动作放开）
遇到低矮一点的树，可以一整个抱住。
When you find a short tree, wrap your whole body around it.
wrap your whole body around it（整个抱住）
paraphrase: 动作放开 → let the move be big / go all in
let move be big · go all in
抱住 → wrap your arms around / hug
scenes.speak: Open your arms and kick your leg — not like that. Do it like this instead — let the move be big. When you find a short tree, wrap your whole body around it.

scenes.title_en: Candid Walking Shots and a Big Seated Pose
scenes.context: 大步往前走时抓拍；坐姿时动作幅度尽可能大一点。语域：生活教学，动感引导。
sentences: 大步往前走的时候抓拍。
Have someone snap a shot while you stride forward.
snap a shot（抓拍）；stride forward（大步往前走）
坐姿的动作幅度尽可能大一点。
When you sit, make your pose as big as possible.
as big as possible（尽可能大一点）
paraphrase: 抓拍 → snap a shot / take a candid photo
大步走 → stride forward / take big steps
scenes.speak: Have someone snap a shot while you stride forward. When you sit, make your pose as big as possible.

practice: Posing like this can squeeze out the flesh at your waist — cover it with your hand.
Turn sideways a bit and reach for your bag strap.
Open your arms and kick your leg — let the move be big.
When you sit, make your pose as big as possible.
pitfalls: I always pop my hip without covering.
Cover your waist with your hand and make one shoulder higher to avoid the squeezed look.
顶胯要配合手挡与高低肩，单独顶胯容易挤出肉肉。
I stand stiffly against the tree.
Wrap your whole body around a short tree for an interactive, natural pose.
抱树是「互动」不是「倚靠」，抱住才显活人感。
Make your seated pose as big as possible — small poses look stiff.
坐姿幅度大才松弛，缩着反而拘谨。
Have someone snap a shot while you stride forward — movement adds life.
走路要抓拍动态瞬间，摆拍走路很生硬。
shifts: 用 cover with your hand（用手挡）、uneven shoulders（高低肩）、turn sideways（侧身）分解小细节
只会说 take a natural photo
用 snap a shot（抓拍）、let the move be big（放开幅度）、alive and natural（活人感）
只会说 stand by the tree
用 wrap your whole body around it（整个抱住）、stride forward（大步走）与环境互动
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：顶胯、高低肩、包带、活人感等按画面与标题确认。
